rows.label: Corporate tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) [national and foral]
rows.value: 25% general; 2026: 19%/21% for companies with turnover under €1,000,000, 23% under €10,000,000; 15% for new companies; 15% minimum top-up tax for groups with turnover of €750,000,000 or more; own rates in the Basque territories and Navarra. rows.value: 19% on profits a permanent establishment transfers abroad; not for EU-resident companies or treaty countries with reciprocity. Paid by non-resident companies with a permanent establishment in Spain. Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 art. 19.

rows.value: 28.3% common and 1.3% professional contingencies plus 0.9% MEI on a base chosen within the band for monthly net income (€653.59 to €5,101.2); reduced quota in the first 12 months. Paid by self-employed people (autónomos). Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 18; Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.

source.title: Orden PJC/297/2026, de 30 de marzo, normas de cotización a la Seguridad Social 2026, artículo 18 (Régimen Especial de Trabajadores por Cuenta Propia o Autónomos) (BOE núm. 79, 31 de marzo de 2026)

rows.value: employee if working within another's organisation and direction (presumed); 15% withholding on professional fees (7% for new professionals), 1% for listed módulos activities. Paid by businesses paying professionals (withheld from the fee). Estatuto de los Trabajadores arts. 1.1 and 8.1; Ley 20/2007 arts. 1 and 11; Reglamento del IRPF art. 95.

rows.value: 6% state rate on real estate, regional rates from 6% to 13%; AJD 0.5% state rate; new homes pay 10% VAT instead. Paid by the buyer. Real Decreto Legislativo 1/1993; each community's tax law; foral laws.
